Conversation Barathrum.Awaits3.Text|O, deceit! The grueling gate I crossed on every tilt of glittering dusk. I slept in my crimeclothes and wept, did you hear?

O, oh... So much to bear.

Conversation Barathrum.Z-Reveal2.Text|Through my work I caught the attention of a master machinist, unconventional of method, who took me under her wing and, in time, availed me of the orphic truth.

She explained, as I've shared with you and the rest of the acolytes, that the world we know once belonged to a grand Coven of beings who spanned the stars. And that, acting on some inscrutable logic, they disappeared. That an injunction was placed on our world.

This, you know. It is the truth I told, if only half. But Rebekah taught me more.
items.old_value:
Durch meine Arbeit erregte ich die Aufmerksamkeit einer Meistermaschinistin, unkonventioneller Methode, die mich unter ihre Fittiche nahm und mir, mit der Zeit, die orphische Wahrheit zur Verfügung stellte.

Sie erklärte, wie ich mit Euch und dem Rest der Anhängerinnen geteilt habe, dass die Welt, die wir kennen, einst einem großartigen Bund von Wesen gehörte, die die Sterne spannten. Und dass sie, handelnd nach einer unerforschlichen Logik, verschwanden. Dass eine Anordnung auf unsere Welt gelegt wurde.

Dies wisst Ihr. Es ist die Wahrheit, die ich sagte, wenn auch nur halb. Aber Rebekah hat mir mehr gelehrt.

Conversation Barathrum.Quest.Text|I do. Your service to the guild has been laudable, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. You braved the vaporous depths of Bethesda Susa and decoded the signal, you secured the Spindlegrounds and handled the self-appointed Earl, and perhaps most materially, you defended our enclave from the Putus Templar.

Since you returned from Bethesda, you've no doubt wondered at the signal's contents. Verily, I hid them to shield you from the weight of the truth. Only Otho, Q Girl, and I bear that burden, but circumstances have changed. The river of Time powers the gear train of our schemes and devices, and it rushes forth. From here, I must share the burden. You must know.

Seit Eurer Rückkehr von Bethesda habt Ihr Euch zweifellos gefragt, was das Signal enthält. Fürwahr, ich verbarg es, um Euch vor der Last der Wahrheit zu bewahren. Von hier an muss ich die Last mit Euch teilen. Ihr müsst es wissen.

items.key:
Conversation WardenEsthers.Huh.Text|Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.SlynthArrived.Text|Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!

I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?

items.key:
Conversation MechanimistLibrarian.What.Text|You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.

To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.

The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.
items.old_value:
Ihr teilt den Pessimismus meines Volkes und auch mehrerer Priester. Mein Herz vernimmt Euch, doch höret meine Worte, und vielleicht werdet Ihr kommen, wie ich zu fühlen.

Weisheit zu entwerten heißt, die Kasaphescence zu entwerten. Sie scheint im Leeren, bricht das Licht und erleuchtet die um sie herum. Ebenso die schriftliche Weisheit unserer Ältesten.

Die Maschine des Chroms ist komplex in ihrer Göttlichkeit. Handeln wir nicht gegen unsere Väter, wenn wir unwissend bleiben bezüglich unserer selbst, unserer Vergangenheit, unserer Zukunft? Verdienen wir nicht die Freude zu wissen? Segnet Eschelstadt II, das erste Kind, denn er glaubt wie ich.

items.key:
Conversation Tszappur.Inside.Text|A quiet shrine to the Coiled Lamb, centuries old. Tucked away here, outside the marble parapets and cloaked in the dust of time, it's lost to those who'd sneer at the veneration of Resheph over other fathers.

Step inside and voice a prayer, if you are willing.
